product_metadata.title: ANERZA 100 PCS Vintage Wall Collage Kit Aesthetic Pictures, Cottagecore Room Decor for Bedroom Posters, Cute Dorm Photo for Teen Girls, Botanical Wall Art
features: 【WHAT YOU GET】70 pieces 4x6 inch vintage aesthetic pictures , 30 pieces 2 inch aesthetic stickers and 1 exquisite packaging box. Wall collage kit covers up to 12 square feet of wall space. Each photo needs to be taped to the wall and can be arranged in any way desired.

【VISUALLY STUNNING】ANERZA vintage pictures are printed on a thick semi-gloss paper with a subtle matte finish to add texture and enhance the details of each image. It is our hope that these beautiful aesthetic pictures will add some color and sunshine to your walls and bring a smile to your face.

【AESTHETIC STICKERS】All the stickers made with high quality vinyl and inks, high-precision printing technology, the pattern is more precise and clear, 100% waterproof and sun protection. Never faded out, uncover the adhesive on the back and use it directly.

【PERFECT GIFT IDEA】Share your love for the classic and groovy by giving this aesthetic pictures pack as a gift. The perfect gift for any birthday, Christmas, Hanukkah, graduation, or any occasion that calls for a celebration.

【QUALITY GUARANTEED】We take extra care to ensure these aesthetic room decor posters arrive at your door in pristine condition. If there are any problems with your order, we’re happy to offer a full refund or replacement.
